slides.sub: Joseph Wright of Derby, A Philosopher Lecturing on the Orrery, about 1766

slides.headline: In a dark room, a lecturer shows a model of the *planets*.
The children lean in. They are watching an *eclipse*.
Inside the rings, tiny brass planets circle a hidden *Sun*.
The lecturer in red. Some say he looks like *Newton*.
His hand rests on the brass *rings* of the machine.
On the left, a man takes notes, completely *absorbed*.
On the right, a man sits lost in *thought*.
On the left, a young woman watches in *silence*.
The lamp is hidden behind a boy. Every face *glows*.
Science was shaking old certainties. Not everyone looks *happy*.
Wonder or fear? Would you want to know how the *universe* works?
